{{Quote|No, I'm not like that, not one of them. I used to&hellip; I used to plague humans. I was fascinated with your kind. I followed, I teased&hellip;you are so exciting!&hellip;and I thought, It might be worth it just to partake of a human, even as the last experience of my life. But I saw the error of my ways, of my thoughts, and I've dedicated myself to helping others see the truth! The truth that we are all the same, that we may commune in joy if we give ourselves to Waru!|The Ghostling woman|<ref name="The Crystal Star">''[[The Crystal Star]]''</ref>}}
Giving up a life of seducing and flirting with [[Human/Legends|Humans]], a '''[[Ghostling]] woman''' became a devotee of the extra-dimensional being [[Waru]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] encountered the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] on [[Crseih Station]] that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and tried to preach to him about her new-found faith. The smuggler assumed she was trying to seduce him, as [[Ghostling]]s were wont to do, and he initially rebuffed her, knowing that any [[Reproduction/Legends|intimate relations]] between a Human and a Ghostling would no doubt [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Ghostling due to their fragile nature. Nevertheless, the Ghostling [[Gender/Legends|female]] protested that she no longer sought to plague Humans and was entirely devoted to Waru.
